tasks.description: Enforce rate limits using a token-bucket algorithm scoped to each API key. This will ensure each key gets an independent allowance. The algorithm should be designed to handle a high volume of requests.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid API key, when a request is made, then the token-bucket algorithm is applied to determine if the request should be allowed or blocked.

tasks.description: Make the bucket capacity and refill rate configurable via application configuration. This will allow for easy adjustment of the rate limits without requiring code changes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a configuration file, when the rate limits are updated, then the new limits are applied to the token-bucket algorithm.

tasks.description: Store rate-limit counters/state in Redis to ensure limits are enforced consistently across all server instances. This will require setting up a Redis connection and implementing the necessary logic to store and retrieve the counters.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Redis connection, when a request is made, then the rate-limit counter is updated in Redis.

tasks.description: When a key exceeds its limit, reject the request with an HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) status. This will inform the client that they have exceeded their rate limit.
acceptance_criteria: Given a request that exceeds the rate limit, when the request is made, then a 429 response is returned to the client.

tasks.description: Include a `Retry-After` header on 429 responses indicating how long the client should wait before retrying. This will help the client understand when they can make another request.
acceptance_criteria: Given a 429 response, when the response is returned, then a `Retry-After` header is included with the response.

tasks.description: The middleware should sit in front of the API routes and apply uniformly to authenticated API traffic keyed by API key. This will require integrating the middleware with the existing API routes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid API key, when a request is made to an API route, then the rate-limiting middleware is applied to the request.

tasks.description: Write unit tests to ensure the rate-limiting middleware is working correctly. This will help catch any bugs or issues with the implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a test suite, when the tests are run, then all tests pass and the rate-limiting middleware is working correctly.
